description: Defines abstract base classes for packed quantized parameters used in linear and convolution operations within PyTorch's ATen library, including method signatures for applying quantized operations, unpacking, and setting biases.

classes.name: LinearPackedParamsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for packed linear quantized parameters, providing interface for applying quantized linear operations, including relu variants, dynamic application, unpacking, and bias management.

classes.name: ConvPackedParamsBase
classes.description: Template abstract base class for packed convolution quantized parameters, providing interface for applying convolution operations with various configurations, including stride, padding, dilation, and transpose options.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Pure virtual method to apply the quantized linear or convolution operation to input tensor.

methods.name: apply_relu
methods.description: Pure virtual method to apply the quantized linear or convolution operation with ReLU activation.

methods.name: apply_dynamic
methods.description: Pure virtual method for applying dynamic quantized operation.

methods.name: apply_dynamic_relu
methods.description: Pure virtual method for applying dynamic quantized operation with ReLU.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Pure virtual method to unpack and retrieve the underlying parameters.

methods.name: bias
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get the bias tensor if available.

methods.name: set_bias
methods.description: Method to set the bias tensor; not implemented in base class.

methods.name: stride
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get stride configuration for convolution.

methods.name: padding
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get padding configuration for convolution.

methods.name: output_padding
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get output padding configuration for convolution.

methods.name: dilation
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get dilation configuration for convolution.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Pure virtual method to get number of groups for grouped convolution.

methods.name: transpose
methods.description: Pure virtual method to determine if convolution is transposed.
